columns.name: currency
columns.expression: case upper(CURRENCY) when '€' then 'EUR' when 'EUR' then 'EUR' when 'USD' then 'USD' when 'GBP' then 'GBP' else upper(CURRENCY) end

models.name: int_customer_deduplicated

dedup_rule.description: latest UPDATED_AT within normalized WEBSITE_DOMAIN, not deleted

assumptions: survivorship by latest UPDATED_AT is acceptable for CRM duplicates

models.name: int_customer_conformed
assumptions: unknown member used for billing customers without a crosswalk
CRM survivorship uses latest UPDATED_AT within normalized domain
revenue is invoiced with paid alongside
